messages:
Maya Patel: Quick brain-dump after the post-launch support triage. We need a concrete operational plan for immediate fixes vs medium-term polish. I want a two-track workflow: "patch lane" (fast, owner-assigned, 48h SLA) and "refactor lane" (planned in next sprint).

Priya Nair: Two-track makes sense. Suggest we make 'customer-blocking' and 'service-degrading' auto-escalate into patch lane. Everything else goes to refactor lane unless SE requests exception.

Oscar Vega: Agree. Also: any patch that touches model config or routing needs a safety signoff from infra (Devon) before canary. Small code fixes can skip that.

Devon Lee: Yep. I'll add a 'needs-infra-signoff' checkbox in the ticket template. We'll carve out a 2-hour signoff SLA during business hours. Outside hours, default to scheduled patch unless it's P0.

Nikhil Rao: From product POV, we should cap patch scope to minimize rollout risk. If the fix is >6 hours or touches shared libs, move to refactor lane and mark as "deferred hotfix" so customers see it's prioritized but not immediate.

Maya Patel: Operational checklist proposal: owners assigned within 1 hour, triage doc in ticket, PR with repro + test, canary to 5% then 25% then full if green. If infra signoff required, schedule canary windows.

Priya Nair: I'll open the "postlaunch-ops" board column and seed it with the top 10 candidate items from support. Please add short repro steps and customer impact count.

Oscar Vega: Small helpful template (paste into tickets):

```
Patch-lane ticket:
- Short desc: <one line>
- Repro / sample request id: <link or steps>
- Impact: <blocked flows, # customers>
- Suggested fix: <short summary>
- Estimated dev time: <hrs>
- Infra signoff: yes/no
- Owner: @<handle>
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (time windows)
- Rollback steps: <commands/paths>
```

Devon Lee: I'll wire the infra signoff checkbox to the release schedule calendar. Also flag: dedicated GPU capacity limited tonight due to cloud provider maintenance. Avoid heavy-run fixes until tomorrow morning.

Nikhil Rao: Communication plan: for anything labeled "customer-blocking", send an update to the affected customers within 2 hours with ETA. Support to own updates, product to own prioritization.

release-bot: Release 2026-03-21T02:15Z: canary deployed to 5% (observability OK) :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: Good progress. Action items: Priya -> populate board; Oscar -> paste template in top tickets; Devon -> infra signoff wiring; Nikhil -> customer comms template. We'll meet in 30m if any P0s surface. Keep updates short in this thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
